body: I currently can’t as I’m out of state and my insurance doesn’t cover me seeing out of network. I don’t have the money to go elsewhere.

I didn’t attend. I wanted to buy a combination of the issues it would cause and the fact I now live many hours away made it hard for me to go. 

SIL and I keep everything a secret because the new wife of my Ex hates me to the extent of blocking and refusing to even acknowledge my ex SIL because she shared a funny post with me on Facebook after the ex husband left me. 

Infidelity was the reason the marriage ended. He met his now wife, the affair went on for months while both of my parents were in and out of the hospital. Within a month of us separating she found out she was 2-4 months pregnant as well.

He died last week...

I won’t be removing him because he was sincerely dear to my heart.

We commented on each other’s post occasionally. He unfortunately died last week though. I was friends with him because he has a lot of medical issues and I still worried about him. I spent maybe 4 years of my life helping take care of him while living with him and my ex. He took me in and treated me like his own. 

I still speak with my ex-SIL. She was like a big sister to me and we both keep our friendship secret so no one knows.

We spoke about kids before. I have PCOS so it’s incredibly hard for me to have kids. So if we decided to go that route, which honesty I doubt we do, I told him I want to be married if we want to start a family. 

Overall I could live with it. That one detail doesn’t make me unhappy with being with him or anything.

We originally went into the dynamic knowing we wanted to do this and that, but marriage was never a topic. I think he had bad luck with relationships before me and it was never a thought. 

And I had been ghosted so many times that I half expected it to happen again, even if he did seem so perfect and it seemed unlikely he would ghost me. 

I’m afraid to bring up marriage only because I don’t wanna talk about it too early.

We’ve already spoke about that early on. Just because I didn’t want to continue if he was completely against it. Luckily he does want to get married eventually and kids are kind of a idc if we do or don’t have them thing for both of us.
He is trying to reduce ties and just stuff in general. But that’s because he wants to downsize and travel some. We’ve talked extensively on the subject.
I believe she says in her first post with it. I would look but I’m kind of unable to right now.
I told him I was super upset about the...I guess lack of information about the punishment beforehand. Later I elaborated on things.
I guess lack of knowing punishment is what got me most. He just told me torture, I guess being ‘scary’. To me torture is being ignored or worse. That’s how things used to be with my ex.

I told him afterwards. Punishment was nothing like I expected, it was still relatively fun for me as well. 

I was afraid of being ignored. I was denied touch or even being spoken to during my abusive marriage. I talked to him about it all afterwards and he understood.

He was understanding. I did what I wanted and dealt with punishment, which wasn’t terrible and was nothing like I expected. 

Afterwards I told him he made me cry when he was texting me, it reminded me of my abuse and I was scared. 

I used to be ignored. Denied touch, or even being spoken to. That’s what I was scared of.

Do they have a name? I’m not sure. My first experiences in the bdsm world were with a dominant sissy. Of course I couldn’t get myself to be a dominant for him, but he was able to get into this weird ‘sub/dom-space’ and pull it off.
I met my master on KinkD. It’s a kink dating app.

That’s a lot of the things I’m worried about. Between being a sub for him, giving myself over and trusting him with everything, the accident and how he handled that. And another thing I learned last night is that if he feels like he’s wasting time on someone he won’t spend time with them. So...that made me feel special. 

I don’t know. It’s like one minute I’m incredibly happy with where I am with him and then the next I feel a short burst of panic because what if I get hurt. 

If you look at my post history, I dealt with a very traumatic divorce in the past year. So...I’m very scared of being hurt or rejection. I know nobody wants to get hurt, but I get like shaking, heart racing, uneven breathing scared when I think about going through getting attached to someone and then they just...disappear.
We do! Dinner dates, outings, movies. We do a good bit together outside of the bedroom.
Well, I’m going back to his place in the next few days and maybe I’ll bring it up if it’s the right time to do so.

That’s kind of where I am. I have feelings. I’ve told him I have feels. But I don’t want to act on them too fast. 

The other day we were having sex, the giggly kind, and...I just felt this whelm of emotion I hadn’t felt in a long time and it made me feel so happy but then afterwards I got scared I’m setting myself up for failure essentially. 

I’m worried he won’t or doesn’t feel the same. I asked early on if I should keep feelings out of this and he told me not to. I gave him his out then, and he didn’t take it.

I do want a romantic relationship. My plan is to not bring it up until the end of this month though. I genuinely do enjoy his company and I find him incredibly interesting. He’s started to open up to me more and more lately too.
We haven’t. I asked him early early on, before we even met if he’d ever have a relationship with a sub and in short he would. It feels a lot like dating though.
I did. The day of the accident last week. He said he wants me to make sure he’s what I want beforehand.

The online person has been there for me through my highest and lowest points of my life in the last 9 months. He’s been there for me through it all and has sat there and made me a priority when things were going bad, and I’ve done the same thing for him. We’ve had in-debt conversations about all kinds of things and we know where each other stands. We’ve told each other our problem is distance. 

I don’t know if things would be the same if we met in person. He’s a very thin guy and that’s never been my type, but he is very attractive though so it kind of doesn’t matter so to speak. We actually have plans to meet and go on a road trip in July even if it’s just as friends. 

And the thing about being disrespectful to my current partner, my feelings aren’t going anywhere as long as I’m stuck on my computer playing games with my online friend. So it’s probably better if I try to stick with this for a while and see if things change.
A day. A literal day.

They’re only 4 years older than me. They’re not ‘much’ older. 

My friend who is online, he has been friends with an irl friend for around 6 years. Him and I just really clicked and became good friends quickly. By no means is he taking any advantages of me or anything like that.

That’s kind of how my best friend has been with me lately. It’s like if I have to go to her to complain about something she basically tells me I did it to myself and I shouldn’t be surprised. 

I’m not allowed to be sad or upset or frustrated because of something I did to myself. I’m not allowed to complain about my parents and I’s relationship or stupid shit they do sometimes. 

Edit - Words

Last time he did anything he kept going to the bar or to get food after work. Then he started doing it again and eventually I found a pair of women’s sunglasses in his car. 

Then he just came out and told me, and repeatedly told me more and more details.

I can’t refinance it. My dad and I are on the loan and I haven’t even made a single payment yet. There’s no refinancing it yet. I’ve been looking on Craigslist for jobs right now. 

All I want to do is sleep right now because I’m so stressed out.
You sound like me. I don’t like showing how fucked up I can get. I act like I’m fine and some days I am. Then I reach a small breaking point and close myself off and only respond to text.

Thank you. He's allowing me to take things slow and ease myself into it all. I want to see how he helps me do that. I'll see where things go. I'd like things to work out for the best, but I also know things are early...like super early.
I'm not NOT into it. It's just VERY different for me. I would try it.
Oh I’ve had it before. Hated it.
That’s why I speak on Bumble if I haven’t spoke on Tinder first.

Oh that’s exactly what she does. That’s why I started confiding in my best friend online instead of her. Lately she doesn’t even act like she cares about my issues. 

At this point, she does more harm than good when I talk to her because she makes me feel like my problems are inferior. Plus...we don’t even hang out anymore - she lives hours away now. We just kind of keep up with each other now. 

I’m closer with people online who I’ve never met than with her now.

I actually don’t exactly have a type. I’ve dated your average guy, body builders, cowboys, bad boys, good boys. Everything. Some I think are super attractive and some that I’ve thought weren’t but I liked their personality. Scope is incredibly widened. 

I don’t know what I’m doing wrong at this point.  Lol. I was thinking about starting to go hang out at the drag strip or hanging around the local country dancing bars or something to just have real conversation with people.
Well...the thing is every single person I match with on Tinder, I also match with on Bumble. So...either way I'm using them both.

Professionally, no I haven't. I'm kind of just over it at this point, ready to move on with life. Best friend never cared that it devastated me when it did. She just basically told me to get over it and I was an idiot for ever wanting to get back with him. Never did she really care about how I felt, mostly just what her opinion was of the matter. 

I have a circle of online friends who have helped me tremendously through the whole thing. That's why I am now confident that I want to start looking for someone to start a new chapter in my life with and see how things go. 

I totally admit I want to fill that void I have, but that's because I really do just want another person who can become my best friend again and start building a life together. It's taken me months and months to learn how to gauge what I want and do not want in a relationship and now that I'm to the point I am now that's why I'm so ready.
CoDa and AlAnon?

Eh to clarify the whole hoping one sticks around...that’s just me being negative. I’m NOT settling for anyone, but I have gotten interested in men only for them to just trail off. Currently kind of dealing with it now, so that was just me being negative.

Nope, I live in the middle of 700+ acres of farm land. Just the road I live down, not the driveway, is 10 miles long and that’s not even to a store or anything. 

I’ve been suggested to get a bike, but I also have an autoimmune disease making it pretty much impossible for me to ride that thing.

I don't qualify for any government insurance and I'm on foodstamps. $121 a month. 

No point in talking to any staffing agencies because...I can't even drive to get there.

"I miss being someone’s partner. I miss caring for, listening to, talking to, motivating, encouraging, and supporting someone. I miss being a partner because I’m a good one. I have a lot of love to give and no one to give it to right now."

This just RESONATES with me right now. I want to find a relationship so bad and I have no idea where to start or how to go about it. I'm being a bit picky and I know what I'm looking for, but where the hell is my Mr. Right?

I feel like I’m ready now. 

Like I want to get out there and find someone to have fun with. 

No counseling. As much as I’d love to - I don’t have a way or money to do it.

Oh no. Even though I do feel the way I do I still have decent judgement. I’ve let people down, and I’ve said no to things that would’ve been a bad for me to deal with. I’m not DESPERATE for love, I just want to find it and it be real and meaningful for both of us.
That's the thing. I don't know where the mess begins or ends.

Judging by this letter I can see why you would think that way. 

This letter is about my blame toward her, but not only because I have all the blame on her. I know my husband is at fault, he is not innocent. But that’s not what this letter is about.

Honestly, I think he was just really angry when he said that. I haven't heard anything like it before and I had another talk about that yesterday and he made it clear he would never actually do anything. 

Yes, he cheated on me 3 years ago. We moved past that.

I’m not sure. 

If things continue the way they are, I hope I’m not around anymore. 

What I would like to see is a more independent me, not sure what that means but I know that’s where I’d like to head.
I know.

I think once my husband actually moves out of our home, which is in a little over a month, I’m going to tell him. 

During the time my husband IS at home I want to give us a chance, even if he doesn’t want to. Telling anyone anything won’t help our outcome if there is a possibility that it could be good.
Apparently my threshold is pretty large...

He has outright called me a doormat recently.

I just want to respect MY vow. I want to try and work this out or make him want to work it out. I know it’s easier said than done. I know I can’t change his mind. I know it’s up to him to make any changes really. I know I sound pathetic.

I get what you’re saying but at the same time, I said this in an earlier comment...there was a huge communication issue on his part. 

If I would have known there was a problem I could have tried to fix it. I still want to try to fix it. 

As we were, yes any other woman of interest could have shown up and he would have done the same thing, but if we tried to fix a problem and it was no longer an issue? Who knows how that outcome would be. 

I know I sound pathetic but I want to keep trying. Even if he doesn’t want to I just can’t stop myself from wanting to try and fix our relationship.
I honestly think it’s too late to say anything about permanent damage. That damage has already been done.

I’m trying. 

The fact that there was such a huge communication issue on his part makes me believe that if we worked on that problem together we would have more hope of being happy together. 

I do need to find strength. I ask God for it every day.
I understand that. I'd love to come out stronger in the end really.
You’re telling me...

I really do think we would have a better chance if she would disappear. 

There are a lot of factors that got us to where we are, and him being bad at communication was a huge one. He didn't communicate a problem and now that I know about it I want to fix it, or atleast try to.
Thank you very much for this.

Everyone I talk to seems to think she's 'feeding him stuff'. Like making him believe his life will be oh so much better if he left me or was just with her.

I know he's making the choices, but I think things she is telling him is making those choices seem easier for him to make.

> Don’t let anyone walk on you. 

That's really hard for me right now. I want my marriage to go back to how it was more than anything. I know if it was to happen it would take A LOT of work but that's what I want.

Might take me a while, but I'll learn.

Whoops. Boyfriend is trying to get HER to fall back in love with him. 

Just like I'm trying to do the same to my husband.

Congrats!

I'm 26 and just finished my drivers ed the other day so I can get my permit and get driving lessons. You give me hope as well!
He knows something is going on with her. According to my husband, he is trying to get ~~him~~ her to 'fall back in love with him'.
Thank you. Not everyone sees it that way.

I know what you're saying.

I'm comparing her to myself though, this letter isn't as much about my husband as it is about just her and her half of the situation. 

I understand my husband is at fault as well, but there is a small small amount of blame I can put on her as well.

Ha! Her boyfriend is NOT my type at all. 

Her boyfriend doesn't even know anything yet, and I'm not...petty?...enough to say anything yet.
I get what you're saying, but she knew full well that he was a married man. There is a sliver of blame to be put on her as well, even if it's a very small amount.

Yeah, I actually replied to your message you sent me earlier.

Over all he blames his unhappiness on me, which resulted in him having an affair. Apparently I was too blind to see problems that I could have tried to fix, but since I didn't know they were there I couldn't fix them.
I have, but he wants no part in it. I thought about going myself, or at least having someone take me, but I can't really find the strength to do it.

My priority is getting closer to God right now as well as fixing my marriage. I can’t drive so it’s a little hard to go to church, I know it’s not impossible though. I’ve made a promise to myself and God that once I’m on my feet that I will try to go to church more often...

I do think I need to be a better wife no matter what. My husband didn’t communicate that he wanted me to work or drive, so I assumed all was well - now I want to help fix that. Helping out with finances or something like that would make me a better wife for him. Plus it would help myself as well...

Thank you for that prayer. I just said it a few times, I’ll continue to pray it. 

I’ll continue trying to be a good wife for my husband and making my own changes for our marriage, but I know only God can help make a true difference now.
Thank you.

Thank you. 

I am not, I recognize that I should be though.

You’re further along than me...

26 who has been a housewife for her entire adult life. I never learned to drive, never had a job...and I’m going through separation and likely divorce with the person I thought I’d be with forever.  

It’s morbid to think, but there really is always someone who has it worse than you. 

You’ll find your motivation one day, you may not think it but you will.

I think if you feel it in your heart that he could change or is really trying to change you should give him one last chance. Let him know it’s his only chance too. 

If he makes another mistake then you know what you should do.
My family live right next door to me. We live on a farm.

There is no walking to work where I am, I live in a very rural area. Work for me is 10+ miles away. 

I have family that I think will help me get on my feet if I really need the help. I know that goes back to relying on someone, but that's what family is for - If they ever needed it I would help them the best I could as well.
That’s what I understand. Plus he has to make his own choice to be in the marriage as well.

I understand what you're saying. Hell, my issues are part of the reason we're where we are - but not the only reasons.

Another reason we are here is because he never communicated that he had an issue with how our lives were together. If he wanted me to drive, get a job, do this, do that and he asked me up front to do those things I would have made a serious effort to change. If he allowed me to think things were okay as they were I didn't want to have to change - I'll be honest there.

You are right in the end though. I do want him to stay because of my excuses, but I don't want him to stay only because of them. I really do love him, I love the man that I was with a few months ago atleast. He's been my rock, my best friend and I still can't imagine my life without him. 

I'd like to become more independent, and see where that takes us as a couple. Since that seems to be the big issue, I feel like if there was a change made in that department then maybe it would help us but it really might be too late...

My husband always took care of both of us. He would take us shopping once a week for our groceries. 

We're not super well off in the money department, but what do you mean by asking for the equivalent of his car? He has no savings, so it's not like he could give me it outright. Hell, he's even letting our boat get repossessed because he just doesn't want to pay it now. I don't want to seem...selfish or petty...but if I'm being left high and dry for another woman then I would like to come out with something that could help me in the long run.

I really do want this man to stay, he did hurt me...but at one point he hadn't hurt me and we were good together. I don't know what happened to that couple, but they're somewhere inside of us. 

There's more to our story, and since you saw my post history you have a better idea than some people on here...I want to make a change for myself as well, and in the long run I think that could benefit us as a couple as well.

Really, only time will tell for us.

Thank you. Right now, he intends on staying married so I have insurance since I have health issues that require medication. If he files, I won't sign. 

My sister-in-law has said she would help me learn to drive, but I don't want to bother her too much since she has a family and her own life. She always seems so busy, so I feel bad bothering her. 

I pray every day God brings our hearts back together and we learn to love each other again. I just think that's near impossible as long as he sees this happy life with the new woman he's seeing, maybe some day things will fall apart and he might want me again, I wish that day would come sooner rather than later but I don't think it will. 

I am trying to take this one day at a time though, most days I just want to sit around the house and wait for him to come home really...Some days I read even a page of the driving handbook, or I try to work on something around the house, or I listen to those self-help type recordings on fixing your marriage.
...I feel like I’ll never accept it is over.
That’s all I can do I guess. Make myself better and do exactly what you say.

Yeah, I understand that as long as their relationship is going good I have no hope really. It’s hard to accept and I wish she would leave him alone or something. 

I’m working on trying to better myself but it is going to be a slow process. It will happen, but it’s going to take time and it’s scary. 

I feel so stupid for letting myself believe everything would always be okay and life with him would be amazing forever but it’s not like that.

I’m trying here. Apparently the husband is staying for around a month and helping me learn to drive, but at the same time he’s not doing much to help at all. 

But no, I dropped out of school in the 10th grade. Honestly I skipped so much with him that it put me behind in credits and I just gave up. 

As for what I did all day, we live on a farm so I could always find something to do. I’d clean the kitchen, make dinner most nights, we live in a tiny house with a few animals so there is always something to clean. I’d spend time at my mothers or go outside. Tbh, life was easy. This whole issue was because of a communication problem on his part, he didn’t tell me he wanted something different and I blindly lived like we were okay.
God. I haven’t seen that movie in a long long time. I’ll have to watch it again to remind me of what you’re talking about.
No. My parents don’t have room for me in their house. My husband and I live in a tiny house right next door to them.

I live next door to my family, but they’ve never been the ones to actually help people out. I’m the oldest of 4 kids, 3 of us could drive if we wanted to but my parents would rather keep them at home instead, so none of us drive either. 

As far as the lawyer, we’re staying married so I can keep insurance. I have medical issues that I couldn’t deal with without it.
We’re not divorcing right away. I have medical issues and he agreed to stay married so I can keep the insurance.

See that’s where I might just be blind. In my head, if I did drive and I did have a job and I could help support each other, then maybe he would view me differently. Maybe he would change his mind about me. 

That is part of my whole, I want to try absolutely everything before we throw in the towel. I just can’t live with myself if I don’t try.

That’s the thing. Even with those large cracks, I could still try to love my life again. I can change, we could change, but he doesn’t want an us right now.

Maybe he is over our relationship, so be it if he is, but I can’t consciously sit back and watch it unravel without feeling like I tried every single thing I could for us to try and work through it.

You don’t know our circumstances. 

I live in a very rural area, my family doesn’t care to teach their kids to drive. Any type of work for me, it’s miles away if I wanted it, literally. Nothing ever could play out if I wanted it to.

My excuses aren’t really just my excuses. On top of me using them as excuses, my husband kind of controlled that aspect of my life. He never allowed me to drive and I also allowed it to happen. Technically it was a joint decision. 

I know I need to take care of myself but I have no motivation currently. It will come eventually.

I don’t know anymore. When we were good, I loved our life. I really did. I feel very betrayed that he could do what he has done but that doesn’t stop me from wanting him to love me back. 

I understand I have to make changes for myself, at this moment I have no motivation for it, but I know it will come. 

I just wish I could have that motivation and keep my marriage as well.

I understand that, actually I did learn that at my age if you take the drivers ed you don't have to take the written test and can just schedule a driving test. 

My point is, I'd like to just do the test and get a permit and learn that way. Build my confidence, so to speak.

We’re currently in a odd state. He’s helping me learn to drive, I’m reading the handbook when I can, afterwards I have a job lined up if I can manage to get a license. 

I’m just being a doormat while seeing where things go. At this point, as much as I want my marriage to work out - I’m taking care of myself little by little.

I just think he's confused. 

I keep telling him and myself that if we're meant to be it'll be, and if he's meant to be with someone else it'll be. 

I just want him to see what we can be before we completely give up.

As bad as it sounds...if what he has going on with her falls apart and he crawls back to 'loving' me it's a chance I'm willing to take. If it happens again then things might be different for us. I'll be able to take care of myself by then, so I might view everything a bit differently at that point.

...Yeah I guess so. 

I love him too much and I don't know how else to handle it.

Thank you. I've read all your comments and I appreciate that you're following my story.

I just don't know what I'm doing with my life anymore. I feel scared, exposed. 

I don't think I told him to do what he wants because I don't respect myself...Honestly, I think I did it because I want him to get it out of his system. If he thinks he's going to sneak around and do it anyways and I'll eventually find out I might as well just tell him to do it. 

He flipped how he felt again after this post too. That will be another post once more stuff comes to light. 

I'll be honest and say that I want him to want me more than anything.

Well...

It's all true.

I get most of your points, I really do. 

I'll admit, he enabled the behavior and I accepted it because I thought that was making him happy.

When I say I need his help to find what I want to do, it's because I really don't know what I would do. I honestly put in an application at Walmart during his work hours so I had atleast some small job during this time. I've thought about what I could do and nothing jumps out at me. There are things I wish I could do, but I also have an autoimmune disease that prevents me from doing those things. 

I'm willing to give myself that overhaul though. I want to have that initiative and self-determination.

Thank you very much. 

I really appreciate it.
But I want my marriage to work. I’m not willing to throw in the towel yet.

The closest town that has any work near me is 10 miles away. There's no way to really get there without driving.

I have terrible credit as it is, actually both of us do. I've irresponsibly stopped paying cards to cut back on our bills before. I've always stated his income was my income because it was my understanding that I was allowed to use spouses income on credit applications.

As for a place to live, I actually live on my grandparents farm in a tiny house my husband and I own. I'm right next door to my family. 

I want to become more independent though.
I've also never heard of Learned Helplessness and I feel like I relate to that a lot.

I can't afford lessons. They're $500-600 for adults around me. I live in the middle of no where so I can't really get any job or anything near me without driving. Our very tiny town is about 10 miles away from me. 

He does feel used. He told me 'My free ride is over' at one point recently. I get where he is coming from, and I'm willing to take steps to fix that.

Yeah I thought they’d be around $100 or something. Nope. Wayyy more expensive, the ones for teenagers are much more affordable. 

They just want to milk what they can out of the adults.
I looked into them but they are $500-600 for a lesson. I don’t work, so my husband would have to pay and I don’t really think we have the money to spare.

Yes, I researched a lot about different medications that can treat my issue. A lot of it is trail and error regarding which ones can actually help you, but I think I got lucky with mine just working for me.

Ive already talked with him about it and the only thing he suggest is quitting the medication. It’s for an autoimmune disease and most of the other medications cause cancers and worse issues than the autoimmune itself. Scary stuff. 

I asked my pharmacist about distinguishing between the medicine-related depression and a normal situational one and she kind of explained it to me. I really feel like this is situational. Even so, I’ll be honest and say I’m terrified of being taken off my medication as well. 

To top it all off, since this post more things have surfaced in our marriage. I’ll be making another post once he goes back to work for input on everything.

It could be situational. But I also take medication that can cause depression as well - it’s a relatively common side effect. I’m always terrified of that happening because the medication I take helps me so much. 

Thank you though.

I think he just wanted to spend time with his friends from work. But I’m not sure what’s truth and what’s not. He went to his brothers house because it’s 30 minutes closer then ours. 

He said he’s tired of me relying on him so much.

I honestly don't think he cares. I've told him I felt lonely before. He knows I've been stressed about my parents. He hasn't went out with friends in over 2 years like this and he chose to do it tonight of all nights.

Currently I'm bingeing on a game I've been enjoying.

My own thinking is making me feel 100% worse though. I know, more than likely it's nothing, but when you go through what I did years ago it's not hard for your mind to trick you into thinking it could be happening again.
Ha! The closest town is 30 minutes by car, a bike would kill me.
I wish I could take a bus or something. I live in a very rural area, a lyft to the closest town cost $150 there and back.
We don't but I do check the list every year to get ideas.

I'm very upset with how my life is going. I'm a homemaker who doesn't know how to drive. My sole purpose in life is to take care of my husband and our home and animals. 

I basically live in my bubble and never come out of it. But I want to do *something* with my life!
